judge_detail: Opened GATES.md (Step 1), PHASE_GOAL.md, and all four output_specs plus spot-checked the underlying artifacts. PHASE_GOAL requires SP-1..13, EG-1..11, CT-1..10 (45 commits) produced and verified. requirements.md/context.md paste real transcripts — git ls-remote showing all four hardening branches at the recorded SHAs on the private remote, sequence gate summaries, and a final verification run at 97b3fe1 (check-and-lint run 2 'All checks passed' 242/242 files, 3669 tests; adversarial OTEL-off 50/50; infra build; real-browser smoke 37/37 single-domain and 47/47 split; connections lane 10/10; netsim 21/21 and the host net-sim scenario table all PASS). I verified logs/ exists on disk with every cited file and that logs/summary.txt matches the pasted copy byte-for-byte, including the honest check-and-lint exit=1 (one flaky test in apps/portal/src/routes/sessions.test.ts, a file no phase commit touches; 6/6 on rerun, full gate green on run 2, both logs retained). I opened one result file per sequence (sp9-platform-daily-ceiling.md, eg5-nsg-module.md, ct3-enforce-img-src.md, ct5-control-apps-split.md): each is a substantive Done-when record citing named tests and command output, with disclosed deviations and Azure-unverified caveats — not narration. The single literal gap is 'merged on the private remote': as of 2026-10-10 the owner rewound main to 792557a and opened ready-for-review PRs #2–#5, so the commits sit on four stacked branches, not merged into main. The evidence discloses this plainly and routes the merge as owner decision #1 in PRESENTATION.md; merging is the owner's reserved action that this gate feeds, so it does not block Step 1's deliverable-production question and does not change the decision. The unchecked PHASE_GOAL checkboxes are explained (fest has no command to tick them and the campaign rule forbids hand-editing fest state; fest progress records 50/54 tasks, the remaining four being this gate's steps).

judge_detail: All four sequences achieved their stated SEQUENCE_GOAL. I opened each SEQUENCE_GOAL.md (all fest_status: completed) and confirmed its required-deliverable list maps 1:1 to the per-sequence "Outcome against SEQUENCE_GOAL.md" tables in output_specs/requirements.md (SP-1..13, EG-1..11, CT-1..3, CT-4..10). Sequence quality gates are proven by transcript, not narration: I independently opened all four results/gate-testing-summary.txt and their exit codes match requirements.md exactly — seq 01 full-gate run1 exit=1 (pre-existing flaky apps/portal/src/deploy/diagnose.test.ts) then run2 exit=0, and browser lane exit=3 (dev container lacked xauth/Chromium), which I confirmed was resolved by opening the genuine 313-line gate-testing-browser-lane.log ending "10 passed (15.1s)"; seqs 02/03/04 full-gate runs both exit=0. No sequence was skipped or left incomplete: grep of fest_status across all task files returns 50 lines all "completed" (01:17, 02:15, 03:7, 04:11), consistent with fest progress 51/54 (the 3 remaining are this gate's own steps). The sequence goals hold as of the stack tip ca0afd1 WITH the PR-review fixes applied, not merely at each sequence's original gate: PR #2 and #3 found real defects in already-delivered seq-01/02 deliverables (the 10-minute LLM call deadline never applied because both hops timed out at 2 min and such calls were charged nothing; a passing probe did not prove the NSG was attached), fixed in c41a69c/149ac5a and carried up the stack — these are covered by the final-verification run in output_specs/logs/, which I confirmed exists in full (summary.txt, head.txt, check-and-lint.log 243 files/3704 tests, adversarial-otel-off 50, smoke 37/37 and 47/47 x2, lanes 10/10 x2, netsim 8/8) and passed first time. Deviations from goal wording are documented adaptations, not shortfalls, each recorded in decisions.md and a named result record: seq-02 NSG (four recorded — pinning opt-in, default deny-list-only, inbound allow of LB ports 31080/31443, removal of the 168.63.129.16 deny Microsoft says must not be denied) and probe (informational wire-server/IMDS checks); seq-03 Report-Only retained as an opt-in measurement mode; seq-04 added hostedAppsLive to separate provisioning from cutover — every one widens coverage or corrects a rule that would have broken installs. Scope note for the next judge: "merged on the private remote" currently means four stacked branches in open ready-for-review PRs (#2-#5), not main, by the owner's 2026-10-10 choice to rewind main to 792557a; PRs #2/#3 await re-review of their fix commits. This is fully disclosed in context.md/PRESENTATION.md and is the owner's step; it bears on Step 1 (PHASE GOAL) and Step 4 (COMPLETENESS), not Step 2 sequence outcomes, which are met. Non-blocking: seq-03 and seq-04 SEQUENCE_GOAL.md state "there are no separate testing, review, iterate or commit task files," yet both sequences do have them (04_testing.md..07_fest_commit.md and 08..11) — a stale note meaning more gates were run, not fewer.
